title: The French test
description: Gary and Richard discuss their exam results after a French test. Gary is relieved he passed English and Maths, while Richard worries he failed the French paper. The lesson covers the use of 'could' for past ability and 'too...to' constructions.
answer_note: Answers for practice section A are from the workbook answer key. Grammar answers are from the grammar practice book key.

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.text: How was the exam, Richard?

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: Not too bad.

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: I think I passed in English and Mathematics.
lines.translation: 我想我的英语和数学及格了。

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: The questions were very easy.

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: How about you, Gary?

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.text: The English and Maths papers weren't easy enough for me.
lines.translation: 英语和数学试题对我来说不那么容易。

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.text: I hope I haven't failed.

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: I think I failed the French paper.
lines.translation: 我想我的法语及不了格。

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: I could answer sixteen of the questions.

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: They were very easy.

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: But I couldn't answer the rest.
lines.translation: 但我回答不出其余的题。

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: They were too difficult for me.
lines.translation: 那些题对我来说太难了。

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.text: French tests are awful, aren't they?
lines.translation: 法语考试太可怕了，你说呢？

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: I hate them.

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: I'm sure I've got a low mark.

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.text: Oh, cheer up!

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.text: Perhaps we didn't do too badly.
lines.translation: 或许我们考得还不太糟。

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.text: The guy next to me wrote his name at the top of the paper.
lines.translation: 坐在我旁边的那个人只在试卷顶端写了自己的名字。

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.text: Then he sat there and looked at it for three hours!
lines.translation: 然后他就坐在那里，对着考卷看了3个小时！

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.text: He didn't write a word!

items.title: pass in
items.text: I think I passed in English and Mathematics. 如果想通过某一个考试，直接用动词pass；如果想通过某一科目，则用pass in。

items.title: paper (可数名词)
items.text: the English and Maths papers, 英文和数学卷子。paper 这个词当"试卷"讲时，是可数名词。

items.title: How about ...?
items.text: How about ...? ……怎么样？用于征求他人意见或询问情况。

items.title: easy enough for me
items.text: easy enough for me, 是指对我来说不难，我可以完成和通过。而 too difficult for me 是指对我来说太难了，无法完成和通过。

practice.title: Practice B: Vocabulary - pairs of opposites
practice.instruction: Match these words into pairs of opposites. Now fill in the blanks.
practice.translation: 找出左框中各个词的反义词。现在填空。
practice.context: Match opposites: hate-love, pass-fail, easy-difficult, low-high, write-read, top-bottom. Then fill in the blanks with the correct words.

questions.prompt: She doesn't hate French tests: she ___ them!
questions.answer: loves

questions.prompt: Of course you won't ___ the exam. I know you'll pass it!
questions.answer: fail

questions.prompt: I like easy jobs: this is too ___ for me.
questions.answer: difficult

questions.prompt: She expected a high mark in the English test, but she got a very ___ mark!
questions.answer: low

questions.prompt: Our teacher always says, '___ the question carefully first. Then start.'
questions.answer: Read

questions.prompt: Where shall I put the date - at the ___ of that or at the bottom of the paper?
questions.answer: top

grammar.title: Grammar I: Answer the questions (could/couldn't)
grammar.instruction: Answer the questions according to the example. Example: Could he read and write at the age of five? → He could read, but he couldn't write.
grammar.translation: 仿照例句回答下列问题。例句：他五岁时会读写吗？→ 他会读，但他不会写。
grammar.key_source: pdf/新概念英语语法练习1_按课程索引.pdf (Lesson 103 I, PDF p.533)
grammar.context: Answer each question using 'could' for the ability they had and 'couldn't' for the ability they didn't have. Item 1 is a printed example.

questions.prompt: Could he read and write at the age of five?
questions.answer: He could read, but he couldn't write.

questions.prompt: Could you play football and tennis at the age of ten?
questions.answer: I could play football, but I couldn't play tennis.

questions.prompt: Could she swim and dance at the age of eight?
questions.answer: She could swim, but she couldn't dance.

questions.prompt: Could he ride a bike and drive a car at the age of thirteen?
questions.answer: He could ride a bike, but he couldn't drive a car.

questions.prompt: Could you speak English and French at school?
questions.answer: I could speak English, but I couldn't speak French.

questions.prompt: Could you wash clothes and cook dishes at the age of ten?
questions.answer: I could wash clothes, but I couldn't cook dishes.

questions.prompt: Could he do his homework and his sister's last night?
questions.answer: He could do his homework, but he couldn't do his sister's.

questions.prompt: Could you buy a car and a house three years ago?
questions.answer: I could buy a car, but I couldn't buy a house.

grammar.title: Grammar II: Complete the sentences (could + time expression)
grammar.instruction: Complete the sentences according to the example. Example: He can run fast now. (ten years ago) → He could run fast ten years ago, too.
grammar.translation: 仿照例句完成下列句子。例句：他现在能跑得快。（十年前）→ 他十年前也能跑得快。
grammar.key_source: pdf/新概念英语语法练习1_按课程索引.pdf (Lesson 103 II, PDF p.533)
grammar.context: Convert present 'can' sentences to past 'could' using the time expression in brackets. Add 'too' at the end. Item 1 is a printed example.

questions.prompt: He can run fast now. (ten years ago)
questions.answer: He could run fast ten years ago, too.

questions.prompt: I can swim five miles now. (last year)
questions.answer: I could swim five miles last year, too.

questions.prompt: He can answer all the questions now. (yesterday)
questions.answer: He could answer all the questions yesterday, too.

questions.prompt: She can drive well now. (two years ago)
questions.answer: She could drive well two years ago, too.

questions.prompt: I can write English well now. (at school)
questions.answer: I could write English well at school, too.

questions.prompt: He can repair a car now. (five years ago)
questions.answer: He could repair a car five years ago, too.

questions.prompt: She can play the piano now. (at the age of eight)
questions.answer: She could play the piano at the age of eight, too.

questions.prompt: He can tell the exact time now. (at the age of six)
questions.answer: He could tell the exact time at the age of six, too.

grammar.title: Grammar III: Answer with 'too...to' (past tense)
grammar.instruction: Answer the questions according to the examples. Example: Have you eaten the pear? (hard) → No, it was too hard to eat.
grammar.translation: 仿照例句回答下列问题。例句：你吃过梨吗？（硬的）→ 没有，它太硬了吃不了。
grammar.key_source: pdf/新概念英语语法练习1_按课程索引.pdf (Lesson 103 III, PDF p.533-534)
grammar.context: Answer each question using 'too + adjective + to + verb' in the past tense. Items 1a and 2a are printed examples.

questions.prompt: a. Have you eaten the pear? (hard)
questions.answer: No, it was too hard to eat.

questions.prompt: b. Has he drunk the soup? (hot)
questions.answer: No, it was too hot to drink.

questions.prompt: c. Have you bought the suit? (expensive)
questions.answer: No, it was too expensive to buy.

questions.prompt: d. Have they answered the question? (difficult)
questions.answer: No, it was too difficult to answer.

questions.prompt: e. Has she taken the medicine? (bitter)
questions.answer: No, it was too bitter to take.

questions.prompt: f. Have you lifted the box? (heavy)
questions.answer: No, it was too heavy to lift.

questions.prompt: g. Has he eaten the cake? (stale)
questions.answer: No, it was too stale to eat.

questions.prompt: h. Have they read the book? (long)
questions.answer: No, it was too long to read.

questions.prompt: a. Can he reach the wall? (high)
questions.answer: No, it's too high for him to reach.

questions.prompt: b. Can they lift the bag? (heavy)
questions.answer: No, it's too heavy for them to lift.

questions.prompt: c. Can you remember the story? (long)
questions.answer: No, it's too long for me/us to remember.

questions.prompt: d. Can she buy the dress? (expensive)
questions.answer: No, it's too expensive for her to buy.

questions.prompt: e. Can he see the letter 'a'? (small)
questions.answer: No, it's too small for him to see.

questions.prompt: f. Can they move the furniture? (heavy)
questions.answer: No, it's too heavy for them to move.

questions.prompt: g. Can you drink the soup? (hot)
questions.answer: No, it's too hot for me/us to drink.

questions.prompt: h. Can they do that exercise? (difficult)
questions.answer: No, it's too difficult for them to do.

grammar.title: Grammar IV: Answer with 'not...enough to'
grammar.instruction: Answer the questions according to the example. Example: Why couldn't he go to school? (old) → He wasn't old enough to go to school.
grammar.translation: 仿照例句回答下列问题。例句：他为什么不能上学？（老）→ 他还不够大去上学。
grammar.key_source: pdf/新概念英语语法练习1_按课程索引.pdf (Lesson 103 IV, PDF p.534)
grammar.context: Answer each question using 'not + adjective + enough + to + verb'. Item 1 is a printed example.

questions.prompt: Why couldn't he go to school? (old)
questions.answer: He wasn't old enough to go to school.

questions.prompt: Why couldn't she clean the blackboard? (tall)
questions.answer: She wasn't tall enough to clean the blackboard.

questions.prompt: Why couldn't he carry the case? (strong)
questions.answer: He wasn't strong enough to carry the case.

questions.prompt: Why couldn't she win the prize? (lucky)
questions.answer: She wasn't lucky enough to win the prize.

questions.prompt: Why couldn't he ride a bike? (big)
questions.answer: He wasn't big enough to ride a bike.

questions.prompt: Why couldn't you go to sleep? (tired)
questions.answer: I wasn't/We weren't tired enough to go to sleep.

questions.prompt: Why couldn't they pass the test? (clever)
questions.answer: They weren't clever enough to pass the test.

questions.prompt: Why couldn't she open the windows? (tall)
questions.answer: She wasn't tall enough to open the windows.

questions.prompt: Why couldn't you go to work? (well)
questions.answer: I wasn't/We weren't well enough to go to work.

questions.prompt: Why couldn't you buy a new car? (rich)
questions.answer: I wasn't/We weren't rich enough to buy a new car.
